fm.name: Mint FM Radio (Q5 Nougat compatibility build)
fm.reason: Original MT6627 receiver app with isolated JNI, current kernel ioctl sizes, and media-group permission. Receiver only; transmitter companion is registration-only.

recorder.name: Audio Recorder
recorder.reason: Mint SoundRecorder depends on missing legacy vendor APIs. This independent recorder successfully captured Ogg audio using the built-in microphone.
